content:
# New client onboarding workflow (process document)
# Drafted with sensible defaults — edit owners, SLAs, and integrations to match your org.

workflow:
  name: new_client_onboarding
  version: 0.2.0
  description: >
    Standard client onboarding process, from signed contract through
    handoff to ongoing account support.

  trigger:
    type: signed_contract
    initiated_by: sales

  inputs:
    - client_name
    - primary_contact            # name, email, phone
    - plan_tier                  # determines SLA tier and provisioning steps
    - billing_details
    - technical_contacts

  steps:
    - id: step_1_contract_handoff
      name: Contract & billing handoff
      owner: sales
      depends_on: []
      actions:
        - Confirm signed contract is filed
        - Notify account management of the new client
        - Confirm billing details with finance
      sla_days: 1
      exit_criteria: Account manager assigned and briefed

    - id: step_2_account_provisioning
      name: Account & access provisioning
      owner: account_management
      depends_on: [step_1_contract_handoff]
      actions:
        - Create client account
        - Provision user seats and permissions
        - Set up integrations requested in the contract
      sla_days: 2
      exit_criteria: Client has working accounts and access credentials

    - id: step_3_welcome_kickoff
      name: Welcome email & kickoff call
      owner: account_management
      depends_on: [step_2_account_provisioning]
      actions:
        - Send welcome pack and onboarding checklist
        - Schedule and run kickoff call
        - Document client goals and success criteria
      sla_days: 5
      exit_criteria: Kickoff completed; goals and success criteria documented

    - id: step_4_setup_confirmation
      name: Setup verification & training
      owner: account_management
      depends_on: [step_3_welcome_kickoff]
      actions:
        - Walk client through product/workspace setup
        - Deliver basic training or point to self-serve resources
        - Confirm any data migration or import tasks
      sla_days: 7
      exit_criteria: Client can use the product independently for core tasks

    - id: step_5_support_handoff
      name: Handoff to ongoing support
      owner: account_management
      depends_on: [step_4_setup_confirmation]
      actions:
        - Share support channels and escalation path
        - Schedule first check-in (30 days)
        - Archive onboarding records
      sla_days: 2
      exit_criteria: Client transitioned to steady-state support

  completion:
    definition_of_done: >
      All step exit criteria met; client is active, trained, and moved
      to the standard support cadence.
    stakeholders_notified: [sales, account_management, finance]

  integrations:
    - name: crm
      purpose: Deal status change to "Won" can also trigger this workflow
    - name: email
      purpose: Welcome pack and notifications
    - name: billing
      purpose: Billing setup confirmation
